svg.title: GovernedGraph — Governed AI guidance with two continuous improvement loops
svg.desc: A connected three-part architecture. The member journey uses host orchestration, Decision 1.1 and Foundry prompt agents, with a deterministic release gate binding authoritative values from a read-only source. Approved content, strategy rankings and domain configuration have distinct consumer connections. Confirmed outcomes enter bounded automatic learning, while eligible declined explanations feed a separate nightly gap-review job and tool-free Foundry agent. Owner-approved changes publish through existing governed content and catalogue release paths. This is an illustrative Azure reference, not a production validation claim.
svg.text: GovernedGraph — Governed AI guidance with two continuous improvement loops
Deterministic facts · bounded learning · owner-approved improvements
